cells.gaps: The last census on record was counted in 2007, and a June 2026 source says none has been completed since. No census in preparation since October 2023 has been found, and no source says none is being prepared.
cells.note: Addis Fortune (ETH-008, June 2026) says there has been no census since 2007 but calls the census delayed, not abandoned, so the whole of rung 1 is not met. No census counted in ten years or in preparation is held, so no rung is reached.
